distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) described Amasa yunnanensis from a female type series collected in Jinping Fenshuiling National Nature Reserve, Yunnan, supporting presence in mainland China.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) states that the biology is unknown and reports no host for Amasa yunnanensis. No host is inferred or promoted.
taxonomy_summary: Amasa yunnanensis Lin, Smith & Meng, 2024 was described as a new species by Lin et al. (2024) and is the current accepted identity.

taxonomic_history.name: Amasa yunnanensis
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species; original-description p. 186.
